brand_notes: XSA Labs (formerly Vera-Fi; designer Viet Nguyen, DIY-origin, Mark Schifter partner) sells direct only; Vanguard is an LS3/5a-inspired sealed 2-way, inverted Harsch crossover. Sister brand Vera-Fi sells $299 Vanguard Scout. Made-to-order, ships ~5-7 days. ASR rejected it; one second-hand claim of woofer unit variation (users-xsa-labs-vanguard). Maker site not scrapeable.
takeaways: ASR Klippel: LW ±4.2 dB, broad 700 Hz-3 kHz hill, f3 77 Hz, sens 81.8 dB (low); pref 2.73/5.48
Impedance min 8.5 Ω @ ~160 Hz (graph-read), benign; THD ~1.8% at 86 dB, ~7% at 96 dB near 100 Hz (graph-read)
Wide directivity (116/117 deg) so EQ helps; ER dip 2.5 dB
Subjective reviewers (Stereo Times, TNT) positive; sharply at odds with measurements
conflicts: Tier A (coloured, bass-light) vs Tier D (praise for balance/bass)
